name: hideout
description: Your crew's hideout in Claude Code: a band above the prompt (plan progress and usage left) and a crew panel (/agents-info): every subagent as a pixel crab, background tasks, the task list, cost and tokens, and the skills and plugins in use.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: workers: when a planned worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts
